sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML assertion containing <OneTimeUse/> twice (same Assertion/@ID). Second submission must be rejected if OneTimeUse and replay cache are enforced.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (same Assertion ID), indicating missing OneTimeUse/replay enforcement.

sequence_description: Test whether Dex's SAML assertion replay cache is incorrectly cleared/invalidated by session revocation, allowing the same Assertion/@ID to be accepted again after revoke (replay across revocation boundary).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_after_revoke_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_after_revoke_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion ID after revoking the prior session; anti-replay state may be incorrectly tied to session lifetime.

sequence_description: Step-skipping attempt: try to POST a forged SAMLResponse to the SAML callback without first initiating an SP-initiated flow (no prior start_oidc_auth). Then run a proper control flow to ensure connector works. Expected: direct callback is rejected; control succeeds.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_unsolicited_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_unsolicited_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted an unsolicited/IdP-initiated SAMLResponse without a prior SP-initiated flow, indicating step skipping and broken flow coherence.

sequence_description: Same-flow principal swap: initiate one SP-initiated flow, then attempt to submit two different SAMLResponses (different NameID principals) against the same RelayState. Expected: only one completion is allowed; second should be rejected as invalid/consumed state (order/atomicity).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a second SAMLResponse completion against the same RelayState with a different principal, indicating non-atomic flow completion and potential cross-principal splicing.

sequence_description: Atomicity/order test: complete a valid SAML login for victim, then attempt to reuse the same RelayState to complete a second login for attacker (state reuse / step reordering).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a second SAMLResponse using a RelayState that was already consumed by a successful login (non-atomic flow completion / state reuse).
